svg.title: Three southern-basin sections / yearly monthly component spans / 1995–2016
svg.desc: 792/792 monthly profiles have paired nominal boundaries. Grey/dash: weak or unresolved, never zero width. Basins remain separate. Finite year-to-year spread is conditional on resolved sections, not measurement error or annual extrema. OSCAR2017.0 / ESR / NOAA PIFSC, near-surface diagnostic. Current association and physical boundary validation remain unresolved.
